subject: Stratus AI onboarding: transition plan & owner assignments
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@stratusai.com>, Michael Cho <michael.cho@stratusai.com>
Date: 2027-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Stratus AI — handoff + MAP and proposed kickoff (action items)

Marissa / Laura — looping you in to transition Stratus AI to CS. Quick summary of the deal: 12-month Dedicated plan (reserved capacity, L3 support), target go-live for inference in Q1. Signed SOW attached.

Key context for CS: 
- Primary use: real-time conversational agents for customer support (avg 60 RPS peak, 800-token median).
- Data sensitivity: PII in transcripts; customer requires SOC2 evidence and encrypted-at-rest keys.
- Integration scope: API-first server-to-server; some front-end JS embed later in phase 2.

Mutual Action Plan (attached) highlights milestones and owners. What I need from CS before kickoff:
1) An owner for the engagement and preferred weekly cadence.
2) Verification of infra checklist (KV cache sizing, batch profile limits).
3) Identification of any gating security docs we must surface before provisioning.

Proposed kickoff: 2027-11-10 10:00 PT (Elena/Michael confirmed availability in last call). Marissa — can you own this handoff? Laura — who on your team should be the day-to-day owner?

Attachments: SOW_StratusAI_v1.2.pdf, StratusAI_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-01T11:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Stratus AI — handoff + MAP and proposed kickoff (action items)

Thanks Karthik — good summary. Marissa, I can take the overall engagement ownership and assign a day-to-day CSM.

Proposed assignments: 
- Engagement owner (contract/exec updates): Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.ai)
- Day-to-day CSM (onboarding & adoption): Tessa Morgan (tessa_morgan@redwood.ai) — I will formally assign in our CS queue today.
- Solutions lead (technical runbook & capacity planning): Vivek Kulkarni

Pre-kickoff asks for the team (I'll run this down with Tessa once assigned):
- Confirm account contact list + access for required systems (HubSpot, DocuSign, shared Drive).
- Verify SOC2 evidence bundle is in the customer folder. Karthik, drop the link to that if you have it.
- Review the MAP and propose any changes by 2027-11-04 EOD.

I can take the 11/10 kickoff — Marissa, if you prefer to lead the first 20 minutes for context, that's fine.

Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-02T08:43:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Stratus AI — handoff + MAP and proposed kickoff (technical checklist)

On Mon, Nov 1, 2027 at 11:08 AM Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Karthik — good summary. Marissa, I can take the overall engagement ownership and assign a day-to-day CSM.

Quick technical checklist / gaps I want tracked before provisioning infra: 
- Confirm expected token distribution for peak vs baseline (Karthik: you had some telemetry; share if available).
- KV cache sizing: recommend starting with 64GB per shard given 800-token median and prefix caching needs.
- Model variant: customer requested a smaller-gen reducer for cost; we should plan for fallback to gptq-8bit variant and benchmark latency.
- Network egress rules: Stratus requires VPC peering + fixed egress IPs for allowlisting; need procurement timeline from their side.
- Compliance artifacts: we need a signed DPA and confirmation of KMS key ownership.

Deliverables I'll prepare before kickoff: 
- Deployment runbook (instantiation-checklist.docx)
- Quick perf baseline script + sample results (will attach)

If anyone sees additional blockers, flag them here.

— Vivek
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@stratusai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Cho <michael.cho@stratusai.com>, procurement <procurement@stratusai.com>
Date: 2027-11-03T16:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Stratus AI — handoff + MAP and proposed kickoff (signed SOW attached)

Hi Marissa / Laura / Vivek,

Thanks for the clear notes. We are good to proceed with the 11/10 kickoff at 10:00 PT.

A few items from our side: 
- Attached: signed SOW (SOW_StratusAI_v1.2_signed.pdf).
- Procurement will follow up separately on the KMS and IP allowlisting windows; they asked for a copy of your network egress IPs and a short runbook for onboarding.
- For the kickoff, please plan to cover: scope summary (10m), security/compliance checklist (10m), infra plan & runbook review (15m), success metrics and handoff plan (10m), Q&A (15m).

Elena Ramos
Head of Platform — Stratus AI
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@stratusai.com>
Date: 2027-11-08T14:06:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Stratus AI — transition plan & owner assignments (handoff confirmed)

Thanks everyone — confirming ownership and next steps on our side: 
- Engagement owner: Marissa Cole (exec escalation, billing questions).
- Day-to-day CSM: Tessa Morgan (will own onboarding tasks and weekly check-ins).
- Solutions lead: Vivek Kulkarni (runbook and capacity).

Pre-kickoff deliverables (I will own coordination):
- Transfer HubSpot contact + access by 2027-11-09 EOD (Karthik, please make sure all contacts are in the record).
- Vivek to upload instantiation-checklist.docx and perf script to the shared Drive by 2027-11-09.
- Laura/Tessa to send introduction email to customer with weekly cadence and calendar invite (will be sent today).

I marked the MAP as "accepted with minor edits" in the shared Drive — see link above. If there are no blockers, we'll treat the 11/10 meeting as the official handoff and start of onboarding cadence.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
